body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #4, company drawn at random from pharma/healthcare + IT services names in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.1 (naive base rate 0.05) that: Between 24-Nov-2026 and 30-Nov-2027 the Supreme Court orders, or GNCTD formally decides (disclosed by IMCL), that the lease will not be renewed or that the hospital be handed over to the government/AIIMS/another operator. Our reasoning: GNCTD already says renewal is 'contrary to public interest' and the SC has threatened an AIIMS takeover; but closing or transferring a running 700-bed hospital is drastic and a year is short. Naive base: [EST] court-ordered takeovers of running private hospitals are rare; ~5%/yr given an active hostile government affidavit. Resolution: YES if an NSE/BSE filing or SC order dated in the window records refusal of renewal or a handover direction (even if stayed later); NO otherwise. Source: NSE/BSE announcements; SC orders. Resolve by 2027-11-30; score with Brier vs the base rate.
